'''''Saiyaara''''' ({{translation|Planet}})<ref>{{cite web |author=<!-- not stated --> |date=<!-- not stated -->  |title=Meaning of sayyara in English {{!}} Rekhta Dictionary |url=https://www.rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-sayyaara | website=rekhtadictionary.com |location=India |publisher=[[Rekhta (website)]] |access-date=23 September 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |author=<!-- not stated --> |date=<!-- not stated --> |title=सैयारा |url=https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/सैयारा |website=en.wiktionary.org |location= United States |publisher=[[Wiktionary]] |access-date=23 September 2026}}</ref> is a 2025 Indian [[Hindi]]-language musical [[romantic drama]] film directed by [[Mohit Suri]]. Produced by [[Yash Raj Films]], it is loosely based on the 2004 South Korean film ''[[A Moment to Remember]]''. ''Saiyaara'' stars debutants [[Ahaan Panday]] and [[Aneet Padda]] in the lead roles of a singer-songwriter duo who fall in love. Originally planned as a [[spiritual sequel]] to Suri's ''[[Aashiqui 2]]'', creative differences led to the project being reworked into a standalone film under Yash Raj Films.

''Saiyaara'' was released theatrically on 18 July 2025 to positive reviews from critics, with particular praise for Panday and Padda's performances, story, and [[Saiyaara (soundtrack)|its soundtrack]]. A major commercial success, the film grossed over {{INRConvert|579|c}} worldwide, emerging as the [[List of Hindi films of 2025#Box office collection|third highest-grossing Hindi film]] of 2025 and the [[List of Indian films of 2025#Box office collection|fourth highest-grossing Indian film]] of the year.<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara worldwide box office: Ahaan Panday-Aneet Padda film beats Kabir Singh, becomes highest-grossing love story ever |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/bollywood/saiyaara-worldwide-box-office-ahaan-panday-aneet-padda-film-beats-kabir-singh-becomes-highest-grossing-love-story-ever-101753800584866.html |access-date=29 July 2025 |website=Hindustan Times }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=24 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara Box Office: Mohit Suri directorial crosses Rs. 200 cr milestone; races ahead to Rs. 225.73 cr worldwide |url=https://www.bollywoodhungama.com/news/box-office-special-features/saiyaara-box-office-mohit-suri-directorial-crosses-rs-200-cr-milestone-races-ahead-rs-225-73-cr-worldwide/ |access-date=24 July 2025 |website=Bollywood Hungama}}</ref>

==Plot==
Vaani is waiting to marry her college boyfriend Mahesh at the courthouse, but he calls to inform her that he is leaving her to marry a rich businessman's daughter to climb the social ladder. She faints after the news and wastes away into depression, giving up her writing

Six months later, she joins Buzzlist as an intern and meets Krish Kapoor, an aspiring musician stuck in his past and abusive childhood and battling with anger. Krish faces multiple setbacks in his musical career, including disputes with journalists, and a row with his band, but KV, his best friend, helps fund the band, although Krish's education is at stake. Krish returns a notebook of poetry accidentally left behind by Vaani at the publishing house and assaults a journalist, and becomes infatuated with her writings.

Although initially wary of Krish's moody nature, Vaani agrees to collaborate on a song for hip-hop singer Prince. Krish helps her to overcome a block and finds torn pages of her notebook at the [[Cricket field|cricket playground]] where he spends his time alone, and she begins to write again. Krish and Vaani slowly become close, and Vaani's world settles into a routine.

However, after Krish confronts his alcoholic father, Vaani comforts him and convinces him to enter [[Drug rehabilitation|rehabilitation]], but Krish is forced to give up the credit for their project to pay for his father's rehabilitation, and he pushes Vaani away, believing she deserves better. They meet again at Prince's concert, where Krish confesses his love for her, and they begin dating, and Krish finally reconciles with his band.

Vaani's parents worry that Krish will harm Vaani like Mahesh did and confront Krish at the hospital after Vaani faints, but they reluctantly agree to let him continue seeing Vaani after Krish promises to do so. However, they learn that Vaani has [[early-onset Alzheimer's disease]], and Krish has to quit his job to care for her, and on the advice of doctors, they move to a guesthouse in [[Alibag]] to make new memories.

At a later concert, Mahesh tries to assault Vaani, but Krish tries to save her, and she, in confusion, stabs his right arm and has a severe breakdown. At the guesthouse, Krish's father reconciles with him, and in one quiet moment, Krish plays a piano tune for Vaani, but she mistakes him for Mahesh and offers to write the words for his melody; Krish leaves to inform his crew that he is quitting the band to care for Vaani, but when he returns, Vaani has vanished. Krish discovers her diary with the words to the song she named "Saiyaara" and records it in her memory before releasing it to the world, where it goes viral, catapulting him to fame and making him reconcile with his band. He continues to tour the country with Vaani's writings.

A year later, KV finds a fan video of Vaani singing along with one of Krish's songs that went viral, and Krish tracks her down to an [[ashram]] in [[Manali, Himachal Pradesh|Manali]]. A letter she has written him reveals that she has fled to [[Manali, Himachal Pradesh|Manali]] to avoid hindering his musical career after recalling the incident at the concert but has continued to follow him, although she doesn't recognize Krish, but he gently reminds her of their time together at the cricket playground. Vaani's memories of their time together slowly return, and she says that she loves him. The film ends with Krish performing at [[Wembley Stadium]] with Vaani by his side as they marry, and Vaani continues to write her thoughts about the wedding.

== Release ==

=== Theatrical ===
The film received a U/A 16+ certificate from the [[Central Board of Film Certification|CBFC]] after 10 seconds of intimate visuals were deleted, objectionable words were replaced in four instances, and a static helmet safety disclaimer was added for two-wheeler scenes.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Fernandes |first=Shefali |date=16 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara: CBFC Deletes 10 Seconds Of 'Sensual & Intimacy' Visuals From Ahaan Panday's Film, Censors Objectionable Words |url=https://www.freepressjournal.in/entertainment/saiyaara-cbfc-deletes-10-seconds-of-sensual-intimacy-visuals-from-ahaan-panday-film-censors-objectionable-words |website=Free Press Journal}}</ref>The film has a runtime of 156 minutes.<ref name="CBFC"/> ''Saiyaara'' was released in the theatres on 18 July 2025.<ref>{{Cite news |date=22 April 2025 |title='Saiyaara': Ahaan Panday's debut film gets title, release date |url=https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/saiyaara-ahaan-pandays-debut-film-gets-title-release-date/article69477360.ece |access-date=26 June 2025 |work=[[The Hindu]] |issn=0971-751X}}</ref>

=== Home media ===
[[Netflix]] acquired the film's digital streaming rights,<ref>{{cite web |title=Saiyaara OTT Release: How to watch Ahaan Panday and Aneet Padda's romantic drama |url=https://www.livemint.com/entertainment/saiyaara-ott-release-how-to-watch-ahaan-panday-and-aneet-paddas-romantic-drama-11753064233333.html |website=mint |date=21 July 2025}}</ref> and it began streaming there from 12 September 2025; the deal marked a significant shift away from YRF's usual streaming partner [[Prime Video|Amazon Prime Video]], with pre-2020 YRF productions later being renewed by the platform as well.<ref>{{cite web |title=Saiyaara to stream on Netflix from September 12 after 50-day theatrical run |url=https://www.bollywoodhungama.com/news/bollywood/saiyaara-stream-netflix-september-12-50-day-theatrical-run/ |access-date=11 September 2025 |website=[[Bollywood Hungama]] |date=11 September 2025 }}</ref> [[Sony Max]] acquired the satellite rights, having been the home of YRF's filmography since 2000. However, the [[Star Gold Network]] later acquired the rights to [[War (2019 film)|War]] and subsequent YRF releases; it then renewed all but a select handful of prior YRF productions for its own catalogue.<ref>{{cite web|title=World Television Premiere: Saiyaara on Sony Max|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWw0_CyYbLg|date = 30 November 2025}}</ref>

== Reception ==

=== Box office ===
''Saiyaara'' closed its theatrical run with {{INRConvert|579.23|c}} worldwide, with {{INRConvert|337.78|c}} nett in India and $19.73 million overseas.<ref>{{cite web | last=Hungama | first=Bollywood | title=Yash Raj Films Box Office Report Card 2025: Rs. 522.91 cr. India nett, $29.18M overseas and Rs. 882.45 cr. worldwide | publisher=Bollywood Hungama | date=2026-01-02 | url=https://www.bollywoodhungama.com/news/box-office-special-features/yash-raj-films-box-office-report-card-2025-rs-522-91-cr-india-nett-29-18m-overseas-rs-882-45-cr-worldwide-saiyaara-saves-scorecard-war-2-turns-spoiler/ | access-date=2026-09-16}}</ref> ''[[Deadline Hollywood|Deadline]]'' described the film's box office performance as "unprecedented",<ref>{{cite web | last=Merican | first=Sara | title=Indian Film 'Saiyaara' Is On An Unprecedented Box Office Run | publisher=Deadline | date=2025-07-29 | url=https://deadline.com/2025/07/india-film-saiyaara-ahaan-panday-aneet-padda-box-office-1236472991/ | access-date=2026-09-17}}</ref> and ''[[The Indian Express]]'' noted that it stood out "at a time when films are struggling to break even, especially the ones starring new faces or debutantes".<ref>{{Cite web |date=26 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara Box Office Collection Day 8: Ahaan Panday's blockbuster has already beaten Kartik Aaryan's Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2, Ranbir Kapoor's Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/bollywood/saiyaara-box-office-collection-day-8-ahaan-pandays-blockbuster-has-already-beaten-kartik-aaryans-bhool-bhulaiyaa-2-ranbir-kapoors-yeh-jawaani-hai-deewani-10150439/ |access-date=27 July 2025 |website=The Indian Express }}</ref>

The film had a record-breaking opening day, collecting ₹21.25 crore (US$2.6 million) worldwide, marking the highest opening for a Hindi film featuring a debutant male lead.<ref name="hungama">{{Cite web |date=19 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara Box Office: Film is historic, takes an excellent 'best ever start' for newcomers |url=https://www.bollywoodhungama.com/news/box-office-special-features/saiyaara-box-office-film-historic-takes-excellent-best-ever-start-newcomers/ |access-date=19 July 2025 |website=Bollywood Hungama}}</ref> Its opening weekend was strong across India, especially in urban multiplexes, with ₹83 crore (US$10 million) net earned domestically and over ₹119 crore (US$14 million) globally.<ref>{{Cite news |date=21 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara box office collection shatters records with Rs 83 crore in its opening weekend. Ahaan Panday and Aneet Padda make history |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/magazines/panache/saiyaara-shatters-records-with-rs-83-crore-in-its-opening-weekend-ahaan-panday-and-aneet-padda-make-history/articleshow/122804611.cms |access-date=26 July 2025 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref> By the end of its first week, ''Saiyaara'' had collected ₹208.5 crore (US$20–21 million) net in India and approximately ₹251.5 crore (US$30 million) worldwide, surpassing ''[[Ek Villain]]'' to become the highest-grossing film of Mohit Suri's career.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Saiyaara Week One Worldwide – 250 Crore Plus – Box Office India |url=https://www.boxofficeindia.com/report-details.php?articleid=9249 |access-date=26 July 2025 |website=[[Box Office India]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=24 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara Box Office: Mohit Suri scores career-best as film becomes his highest-grossing release ever |url=https://www.bollywoodhungama.com/news/box-office-special-features/saiyaara-box-office-mohit-suri-scores-career-best-film-becomes-highest-grossing-release-ever/ |access-date=26 July 2025 |website=Bollywood Hungama }}</ref> On its eighth day, the film maintained momentum, earning ₹17.5 crore (US$2.1 million) net.<ref>{{Cite news |date=26 July 2025 |title='Saiyaara' box office collection Day 8: Mohit Suri's romantic drama crossed Rs 190 crore mark; Ahaan Panday and Aneet Padda starrer to enter Rs 200 crore club today |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/bollywood/box-office/saiyaara-box-office-collection-day-8-mohit-suris-romantic-drama-crossed-rs-190-crore-mark-ahaan-panday-and-aneet-padda-starrer-to-enter-rs-200-crore-club-today/articleshow/122915369.cms |access-date=26 July 2025 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> On 26 July 2025 (its ninth day), it crossed the ₹200 crore (US$24 million) milestone domestically with an additional ₹15.3 crore (US$1.8 million), becoming the second fastest Hindi film of 2025 to enter the ₹200 crore club. The film crossed the ₹300 crore mark on its ninth day.<ref>{{Cite web |date=27 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara Box Office: Mohit Suri directorial crosses Rs. 300 cr worldwide, hits new benchmark in just 9 days |url=https://www.bollywoodhungama.com/news/box-office-special-features/saiyaara-box-office-mohit-suri-directorial-crosses-rs-300-cr-worldwide-hits-new-benchmark-just-9-days/ |access-date=28 July 2025 |website=Bollywood Hungama }}</ref>Its total stood at {{INRConvert|220.75|c}} nett in India and {{INRConvert|327.74|c}} gross worldwide by the end of day ten. By this point, ''Saiyaara'' had already outperformed the lifetime totals of [[Raid 2 (film)|''Raid 2'']], ''[[Sitaare Zameen Par]]'' and ''[[Housefull 5]]'' becoming the [[List of Hindi films of 2025|third highest-grossing Hindi film of 2025]] as well as the [[List of Indian films of 2025|fourth highest-grossing Indian film of the year]]. This made it the second-biggest opening week for a Hindi release in 2025, behind ''Chhaava''. By its twelfth day of release, the film had earned an estimated ₹270.75 crore (US$32 million) net in India, with a domestic gross of ₹319.5 crore (US$38 million). Its overseas earnings stood at ₹86 crore (US$10.8 million), bringing its total worldwide gross to ₹404 crore (US$48 million), surpassing ''[[Kabir Singh]]'' as the highest-grossing Indian romantic film of all time.<ref>{{Cite news |date=30 July 2025 |title='Saiyaara' creates Box Office history: Ahaan Panday-Aneet Padda's film crosses Rs 400 crore worldwide; beats 'Kabir Singh' to become highest-grossing Indian romantic film |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/bollywood/box-office/saiyaara-creates-box-office-history-ahaan-panday-aneet-paddas-film-crosses-rs-400-crore-worldwide-beats-kabir-singh-to-become-highest-grossing-indian-romantic-film/articleshow/122988168.cms |access-date=30 July 2025 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> Within thirteen days, it had climbed to become the 22nd highest-grossing Hindi film of all time, surpassing ''[[RRR (film)|RRR]]'' and ''[[Dhoom 3]]''.<ref>{{Cite news |date=31 July 2025 |title=Mohit Suri, Ahaan Panday and Aneet Padda's 'Saiyaara' becomes 22nd biggest hit of Hindi cinema, surpassing Jr NTR's 'RRR' and Aamir Khan's 'Dhoom 3' |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/bollywood/box-office/mohit-suri-ahaan-panday-and-aneet-paddas-saiyaara-becomes-22nd-biggest-hit-of-hindi-cinema-surpassing-jr-ntrs-rrr-and-aaamir-khans-dhoom-3/articleshow/123011354.cms |access-date=1 August 2025 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref>

=== Critical response ===
{{Rotten Tomatoes prose|63|5.1|19|consensus=|access-date={{RT data|access date}}}}<ref>{{Cite web |title=Saiyaara |url=https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/saiyaara |access-date=23 July 2025 |website=Rotten Tomatoes}}</ref>

The film received generally positive reviews from critics, with the lead performances and soundtrack garnering the most praise. ''[[Bollywood Hungama]]'' gave 4 out of 5 stars and described it as "a stirring musical saga" that was elevated by Mohit Suri's deft direction, heartfelt romance, chart-topping music, and the stellar performances of its debutant leads.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hungama |first=Bollywood |date=18 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara Movie Review: SAIYAARA is a captivating cinematic experience. |url=https://www.bollywoodhungama.com/movie/saiyaara/critic-review/saiyaara-movie-review/saiyaara-is-a-captivating-cinematic-experience/ |access-date=18 July 2025 |website=[[Bollywood Hungama]] }}</ref> Rishabh Suri of the ''[[Hindustan Times]]'' gave 3.5/5 stars and opined that while the story did not break new ground, it struck the right emotional chords, understood its audience, and delivered with sincerity, adding that "sometimes, that is more than enough".<ref>{{Cite web |last=Suri |first=Rishabh |date=18 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara movie review: Ahaan Panday, Aneet Padda's chemistry, soulful music give life to Mohit Suri's cliched love story |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/bollywood/saiyaara-movie-review-ahaan-panday-aneet-paddas-chemistry-soulful-music-give-life-to-mohit-suris-cliched-love-story-101752827656927.html#google_vignette |access-date=18 July 2025 |website=[[Hindustan Times]]}}</ref> Vineeta Kumar of ''[[India Today]]'' gave 3.5/5 stars and found the film entertaining, emotional, and musical: a cinematic piece where the flaws were visible but the heart shone through.<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara review: Ahaan Panday's starry debut for hearts that loved, lost and healed |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/movies/reviews/story/saiyaara-movie-review-ahaan-panday-starry-debut-for-hearts-that-loved-lost-and-healed-2757783-2025-07-18 |access-date=18 July 2025 |website=India Today }}</ref>

Other critics were more reserved, pointing out the familiar storyline and uneven pacing. Radhika Sharma of ''[[NDTV]]'' gave 3/5 stars, summarising the plot as "as old as time": a bad boy meets a good girl, sparks fly, heartbreak and sacrifice follow, and then a reunion, but acknowledged Mohit Suri's strong command over heartbreak.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Saiyaara Review: No One Does Heartbreak Like Mohit Suri |url=https://www.ndtv.com/entertainment/saiyaara-review-no-one-does-heartbreak-like-mohit-suri-ahaan-panday-aneet-padda-3-stars-8899426 |access-date=18 July 2025 |website=NDTV }}</ref> Vinamra Mathur of ''[[Firstpost]]'' gave 3/5 stars and noted that while the love story was messy and imperfect, the lead actors sailed through it with conviction.<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 July 2025 |title=Mohit Suri's 'Saiyaara' movie review: Ahaan Panday and Aneet Padda sail through this messy, imperfect love story |url=https://www.firstpost.com/entertainment/mohit-suris-saiyaara-movie-review-ahaan-panday-and-aneet-padda-sail-through-this-messy-imperfect-love-story-13908325.html |access-date=18 July 2025 |website=Firstpost }}</ref> Kusumika Das of ''[[Times Now]]'' gave 2.5/5 stars and felt the film aimed for the stars but only touched the clouds; the soul of the film lay in the performances, with occasional flashes of classic Mohit Suri magic in lines like "Mera na hona, tumhare bade hone ka wajah banega".<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara Movie Review: Ahaan Panday, Aneet Padda Act Their Hearts Out In This Mohit Suri Film Lacking Soul |url=https://www.timesnownews.com/entertainment-news/reviews/saiyaara-movie-review-ahaan-panday-aneet-padda-sparkle-never-sizzle-in-mohit-suris-tepid-love-story-review-152300634 |access-date=18 July 2025 |website=Times Now }}</ref> Aishwarya Vasudevan of ''[[OTTplay]]'' gave 3/5 stars and wrote that the film "doesn’t reinvent the wheel of romance, but it sure makes it spin with heart", and praised the harmony between the two lead actors.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Saiyaara review: Mohit Suri's romance gets a fresh coat with Ahaan and Aneet |url=https://www.ottplay.com/review/saiyaara-review-mohit-suri-old-school-romance-gets-a-fresh-coat-with-ahaan-panday-aneet-padda/89389500e6379 |access-date=18 July 2025 |website=OTTPlay }}</ref> Jaya Dwivedie of ''[[India TV]]'' gave 3/5 stars and described the film as a slow-paced love story that tried to reach the audience's hearts despite its unfamiliarity and incompleteness.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Dwivedie |first=Jaya |date=18 July 2025 |title=Saiyaara Movie Review: Ahaan Panday and Aneet Padda shine bright but Mohit Suri's love story fails to make a mark |url=https://www.indiatvnews.com/entertainment/movie-review/saiyaara-movie-review-ahaan-panday-and-aneet-padda-shine-bright-but-mohit-suri-s-love-story-fails-to-make-a-mark-1061 |access-date=18 July 2025 |website=[[India TV]]}}</ref>
